name: Noelle
title: Chivalric Blossom
description: A maid who faithfully serves the Knights of Favonius. She dreams of joining their ranks someday.

skills.name: Favonius Bladework - Maid
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 4 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous spinning attacks against all nearby opponents.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground below, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: Breastplate
skills.description:
Summons protective stone armor, dealing Geo DMG to surrounding opponents and creating a shield. The shield's DMG Absorption scales based on Noelle's DEF.
The shield has the following properties:
·When Noelle's Normal and Charged Attacks hit a target, they have a certain chance to regenerate HP for all characters.
·Possesses 150% DMG Absorption efficiency against all Elemental and Physical DMG.

The amount of HP healed when regeneration is triggered scales based on Noelle's DEF.
skills.info: Noelle is both a dutiful maid and a valiant knight.

skills.name: Sweeping Time
skills.description:
Gathering the strength of stone around her weapon, Noelle strikes the opponents surrounding her within a large AoE, dealing Geo DMG.
Afterwards, Noelle gains the following effects:
·Larger attack AoE.
·Converts attack DMG to Geo DMG that cannot be overridden by any other elemental infusion.
·Increased ATK that scales based on her DEF.
skills.info: Sometimes, it's not just dust that needs sweeping...

passives.name: Devotion
passives.description:
When Noelle is in the party but not on the field, this ability triggers automatically when your active character's HP falls below 30%:
Creates a shield for your active character that lasts for 20s and absorbs DMG equal to 400% of Noelle's DEF.
The shield has a 150% DMG Absorption effectiveness against all Elemental and Physical DMG.
This effect can only occur once every 60s.

passives.name: Nice and Clean
passives.description:
Noelle will decrease the CD of Breastplate by 1s for every 4 Normal or Charged Attack hits she scores on opponents.
One hit may be counted every 0.1s.

passives.name: Maid's Knighthood
passives.description: When a Perfect Cooking is achieved on a DEF-boosting dish, Noelle has a 12% chance to obtain double the product.

constellations.name: I Got Your Back
constellations.description: While Sweeping Time and Breastplate are both in effect, the chance of Breastplate's healing effects activating is increased to 100%.

constellations.name: Combat Maid
constellations.description: Decreases the Stamina Consumption of Noelle's Charged Attacks by 20% and increases her Charged Attack DMG by 15%.

constellations.name: Invulnerable Maid
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Breastplate by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: To Be Cleaned
constellations.description: When Breastplate's duration expires or it is destroyed by DMG, it will deal 400% of Noelle's ATK as Geo DMG to surrounding opponents.

constellations.name: Favonius Sweeper Master
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Sweeping Time by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Must Be Spotless
constellations.description:
Sweeping Time increases Noelle's ATK by an additional 50% of her DEF.
Additionally, every opponent defeated during the skill's duration adds 1s to the duration, up to 10s.

outfits.name: Armored Rose
outfits.description: Noelle's outfit. Heavy clothing made of durable velvet and metal plates.

voices.title: Hello
voices.text: My name is Noelle, maid of the Knights of Favonius, and it's my pleasure to be joining you on your adventure today. Should you encounter any problems at all at any point throughout your journey, please do not hesitate to call me and I will be delighted to provide you with my full assistance. Yes, starting right now — what do you need?

voices.title: Chat: A Favor
voices.text: Leave it to me! All of it, whatever it is! ...What... exactly is "it"? I didn't quite catch your request...

voices.title: Chat: Rest
voices.text: You seem tired. Would you like some tea? I'll brew you some. Do you take sugar? One cube, or two?

voices.title: Chat: Being Reliable
voices.text: Whenever you need me, I'll be there.

voices.title: When It Rains
voices.text: Oh dear, everyone's laundry is still on the line! May I be excused to fetch it in?

voices.title: When Thunder Strikes
voices.text: Please stay indoors until the storm passes. I will deal with any urgent outdoor business.

voices.title: When the Sun Is Out
voices.text: Mmm, such fair weather. Why don't we do a bit of sunny work? Oh, what sort of work is that, you ask? Haha, well, anything that makes you feel bright and sunny too.

voices.title: When It's Windy
voices.text: Ahh... Can you hear the Anemo Archon's voice on the breeze? It calms me down whenever I get flustered.

voices.title: Good Morning
voices.text: Good morning! Breakfast is served. I will be on hand the whole time. Should you find that anything is not to your taste, please, do not hesitate to let me know.

voices.title: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Ready for your tea break? Please wait here while I get it ready. Oh yes, I also made Lighter-Than-Air Pancakes! You simply must try one, it's my specialty.

voices.title: Good Evening
voices.text: Everyone has free time in the evening, and that is when I am busiest. Where have Amber's washed hairbands been placed? How many new eyepatches did Kaeya buy? Keeping track of all these things is a maid's responsibility.

voices.title: Good Night
voices.text: Please get some rest, you must be tired from today's adventure. I should head back to the Knights of F— Sorry? You want me to watch over you until you fall asleep? I—I... I mean, of course, it's no problem. But, um... You're not just teasing me, are you?

voices.title: About Noelle: Discipline
voices.text: In my job, I do the exact same things every day — a far cry from being a true knight, that's for sure. But ultimately, this is all part of my training, and when it comes to training, actions speak louder than words.

voices.title: About Noelle: Disagreement
voices.text: I'm a bit useless in an argument because I can't really explain my reasoning clearly. People find that hard to understand, so instead, I try to just get on with my work in my own way. But then they call me stubborn. All I try to do is convince people with results instead of trying to talk them round... Is that really stubborn of me?

voices.title: About Us: Identities
voices.text: I am devoted to what I do, but make no mistake — I devote myself freely. A maid, to me, is the most liberating job there is. I'm a chef, a gardener, a warrior, a guide... I can be anything you need me to be!

voices.title: About Us: Reminders
voices.text: Even when you're too busy to eat three square meals, never eat something if you don't know where it came from, and always maintain a balance between meat and vegetables. Oh, and no swimming right after a meal. Haha, I do hope you're not thinking, "that's too much trouble, I'll just leave it to Noelle," are you? ... Oh... but of course, if you are... Well then, just leave it to me.

voices.title: About Us: Welcome Party
voices.text: So I hear you're an Honorary Knight of Favonius? I envy you! I suppose that makes you my senior... Anyway, it's about time someone threw you a welcome party, surely? Leave it to me!

voices.title: About the Vision
voices.text: To be honest, I'm feeling a little dejected. Sure, this Vision proves that the Archons think I'm worthy, but why is it a Geo Vision? I mean, Geo's the furthest thing from Anemo, and for a Knight of Favonius...

voices.title: Something to Share
voices.text: I actually really like the smell of wine, I'm just not of drinking age yet. There've been a few times when I could've had a little taste if I'd wanted, and no one would ever have known... but I resisted the temptation. I feel like the first time you try it is probably really magical, so I want to save it till I'm older.

voices.title: Interesting Things
voices.text: A maid is required to keep everyone's secrets. That's why my favorite flower is the rose. Here in Mondstadt, the rose represents the saying, "As wine bottles are corked, so too my lips are sealed." It reminds me to— What? ...Roses represent love in your hometown? I—I had no idea the rose held such a... passionate meaning.

voices.title: About Amber
voices.text: I really look up to Amber. Not only is she an accomplished knight, but she's a kind person too. She taught me how to make a Baron Bunny. I keep it on my person for luck, and it looks quite alright I think. Oh no, please do not be alarmed. There's no risk of explosion whatsoever.

voices.title: About Klee
voices.text: I've always been curious as to how she managed to become a fully-fledged knight at such a young age. I actually went to ask her for tips once, but I'd barely started talking to her when she grabbed me by the hand and took me outside the Knights headquarters to play with bombs. I thought it was some kind of training exercise at first, but Jean found us, and we both ended up in solitary confinement...

voices.title: About Jean
voices.text: Master Jean has always been my role model, both in terms of ability and dedication. She holds herself and others to the same high standards, so if there ever comes a day when I meet with her approval, it will be the ultimate acknowledgment of all my efforts so far. Until then, there's no room for complacency!

voices.title: About Varka
voices.text: At first I wanted to join his expedition party and do my part as a maid. But the Grand Master said no — it would give him more peace of mind if I stayed behind to take care of things in Mondstadt. It made me so happy to hear how much he values me! ...Okay, so apparently he said the same thing to a lot of people. But that doesn't change the fact he prizes me too!

voices.title: About Kaeya
voices.text: He's a mysterious character! He comes and goes like the wind, and is always occupied with important business. I like the fact that he delegates some of the smaller jobs to me sometimes, it's nice to feel like part of the team, you know... What do you mean, "errand runner"? I don't see it like that at all! Okay, well yes, technically I run errands for him. But still, I really appreciate it!

voices.title: About Bennett
voices.text: He's asked me to join the Adventurers' Guild more than a few times, saying that life there would suit me better than with the Knights of Favonius. While I could help him take care of his "dads" like the other adventurers... the Knights hold a special meaning for me, and I'm not ready to give up on becoming one yet. No, I simply cannot accept his offer.

voices.title: About Fischl: Tea
voices.text: I think she's from another world, but I don't know the details. One thing I do know, however, is that she loves the Knights of Favonius' library. She can always be found there with her nose in a book. I bring her some refreshments whenever I go in there to clean, and she always thanks me profusely. When I say profusely... I mean she goes a bit over the top, to be honest, and... I actually don't understand half of what she's saying.

voices.title: About Fischl: Background
voices.text: So once when I was cleaning the library, I noticed a book on the shelf called Flowers for Princess Fischl. At the time I assumed it was just a fantasy novel... I was so surprised to find out the main character is a real person. I could hardly believe it! She must be someone incredible to have a whole book dedicated to her.

voices.title: About Barbara
voices.text: We take tea breaks together sometimes. Often she'll start humming a tune, saying inspiration has come to her. I'm not the right person to give useful feedback on anything musical... But I still love spending time with Barbara.

voices.title: More About Noelle: I
voices.text: How may I be of assistance? ...Oh, you just want to chat? Okay then! Well, if that's how I can help, then please feel free to chat as long as you'd like.

voices.title: More About Noelle: II
voices.text: Not a problem, I'm here to serve in whatever capacity you require. You needn't be concerned about the way I feel. ...Huh? More tool than maid? I disagree! A tool might help you to complete a million tasks to a satisfactory standard, but it feels nothing. I, on the other hand, feel a strong sense of achievement every time I do something for you.

voices.title: More About Noelle: III
voices.text: Th—These treats are for me? Oh no, I couldn't, really. Well... Then I'll make some for you too! I'll go right now, right this instant! Half an hour... Ah, okay, maybe an hour, tops. You can busy yourself with other things first, and I'll be sure to deliver them right to you, hot and fresh out of the oven!

voices.title: More About Noelle: IV
voices.text: I spend all my days handling the most trivial of matters, but so long as it helps you in your adventure, or makes your life easier in some small way, I couldn't be happier. That's because each time I get a thank-you, it makes me feel like my work at least has some meaning, no matter how insignificant it seems.

voices.title: More About Noelle: V
voices.text: Even though I mostly work for the Knights of Favonius, I'm always looking out for ways I can help more people. These days, though, I seem to be spending more and more of my time with you... It might be a bit selfish of me... What do you think?

voices.title: Noelle's Hobbies
voices.text: My hobby? I really like washing all sorts of things... clothes, floorboards, windows, you name it! Whenever I see something dirty, I just want to give it a good old clean! It gives me such a sense of achievement! ...Oh, you mean the things I do in my free time? Hmm... Same answer!

voices.title: Noelle's Troubles
voices.text: How to get more for your Mora? Last time I went all the way to Liyue, I visited every single shop to compare prices, and then carried everything back myself... I won't be doing that again though. I was on the road for so long that Jean was convinced I'd been gobbled up by Stormterror along the way!

voices.title: Favorite Food
voices.text: My favorite is easily a Satisfying Salad. The best of Mondstadt's natural produce on one plate — highly nutritious, and a low calorie count. No, I never get sick of eating it — it's delicious! I've been eating it for ten years now.

voices.title: Least Favorite Food
voices.text: I'm not a fussy eater, but I really don't like banquets... The reason being, as the maid, I'm expected to sample every single dish on the table to ensure its quality. Just one bite of each, of course, but it all adds up... Oh, the guilt...

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: I
voices.text: How can you make such a simple dish taste so good? My admiration towards you just keeps growing!

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: II
voices.text: This tastes wonderful! Uh, would you mind teaching me how to make this? After all, it is my duty as a maid...

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: III
voices.text: Hmm... This is more than I normally eat in a whole day...

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Since you're always so busy adventuring, there must be so many little things you never get round to, surely? Well, you need not worry about them adding up, because today, I am all yours — your exclusive maid for the entire day! Just leave it all to me! ...Also, I'd like to take this opportunity to wish you a very happy birthday!

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Intro
voices.text: What is this... new power!? Thank you! Now I can be of assistance to even more people.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Building Up
voices.text: I cannot rest on my laurels. After all, I'm not even formally a knight yet. Until that day, I must work even harder.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Climax
voices.text: Thank you for the opportunity to accompany you on your adventures, it's taught me a lot and I believe I have improved a lot. As a maid, I should be the one serving you, but it seems you have done more for me than I could ever imagine...

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Conclusion
voices.text: Everyone in Mondstadt is saying that I'm much more reliable now. Some even say that I'm to be made a true knight soon, but I don't think— What? You think so too? Awwww... Thank you! Coming from you, that is the best compliment I could ever hope for!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: I
voices.text: Steady as stone.

voices.title: Elemental Skill: II
voices.text: I must leave no stone unturned.

voices.title: Elemental Skill: III
voices.text: Leave it all to me.

voices.title: Elemental Burst: I
voices.text: Time to clean up.

voices.title: Elemental Burst: II
voices.text: As a good knight should.

voices.title: Elemental Burst: III
voices.text: As a dutiful maid would.

voices.title: Sprint Start: I
voices.text: I'll catch up.

voices.title: Sprint Start: II
voices.text: Someone needs assistance.

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: I
voices.text: All in a day's work.

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: II
voices.text: Oh, wonderful...

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: III
voices.text: A little dusty... Best give it a spring-cleaning!

voices.title: Low HP: I
voices.text: I can patch myself up.

voices.title: Low HP: II
voices.text: Ugh, that's going back in the wash...

voices.title: Low HP: III
voices.text: If at first you don't succeed...

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: I
voices.text: Apply continuous pressure to the wound.

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: II
voices.text: Let me get this. You need medical attention!

voices.title: Fallen: I
voices.text: I am a disgrace... to the knights...

voices.title: Fallen: II
voices.text: But they still need me...

voices.title: Fallen: III
voices.text: It was my honor to serve you...

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: I
voices.text: Ugh... I missed a spot...

voices.title: Joining Party: I
voices.text: Ohhh, how exciting! Ahem.

voices.title: Joining Party: II
voices.text: I will protect you.

voices.title: Joining Party: III
voices.text: As you wish.
